$comment: Source of truth: pillar manifest JSON on disk (operator-controlled config). Not a DHT entry; the entries this schema describes live in elohim/sdk/domains/<pillar>/manifest.json under the governance-actions section.
title: ManifestGovernanceActionDeclaration
description: Per-kind governance-action declaration inside a pillar manifest's governance-actions section. Maps a governance-action kind to its child-attestation kind and default ballot semantics. Source of truth is the manifest JSON file on disk.

child_attestation_kind.description: The attestation_kind that a vote-child of this governance-action uses (e.g., 'attestation:renewal-approval' for governance-action:renewal-request)

default_eligibility_predicate.description: Default eligibility check applied when the proposing agent doesn't provide one explicitly. Null means default-all-eligible.
